analyst_view.overall: Early view: two sides on 3 points that may both need a win to stay in the top 24. Marseille finally won in Europe at Leverkusen and won again at Lens, while Celta (11th in La Liga with seven draws in 12) have lost three of four European games and had a long injury list in early November.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals. I lean lower: Marseille have scored two goals in four European games and Celta's La Liga games have produced only 20 goals in 12. Celta's 2-1 defeats to Juventus and Union show they keep games close, so 2-1 or 1-0 fits better than a high score.

corners.text: The numbers say 7.9 corners. I lean higher: Celta keep the ball and won 11 corners to 1 at home to Union, and Marseille at the Velodrome will push hard for a win they probably need, so corners at both ends look likely.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.9 cards. I lean a little higher: with elimination a real risk for whoever loses, the second half could get scrappy, and the Velodrome tends to make visiting defenders' lives difficult. The referee is not known yet.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.2 shots. I lean a little lower: Marseille won at Leverkusen with only eight shots and their European attack has been blunt, while Celta's domestic games are short on chances.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 shots on target. For the same reasons I lean lower: Marseille managed two on target at Leverkusen, and only a Borja Iglesias return would make Celta more dangerous than their recent output.
